description: HushPinterest v0.0.8: 29 patches for Pinterest 14.39.0, which needs Android 10 or newer. New in this release: a long press on the Pinterest logo opens HushPinterest settings, AMOLED black and Hide closeup buttons are new patches, settings got a redesign, and downloads can wait for an unmetered network. Validation: 858 runtime tests passed. All 212 patch tests passed. All 29 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.39.0. Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.
